title: Electropaint 1989
author: David A. Tristram, NASA Ames
blurb: The mature IRIS GL Electropaint from Panel Library 9.6, driven here by Tristram's own default script: self-animating sliders, mirror-fold ribbons, a spectrum colormap.
port: Runs in colour-index mode with a spectrum colormap; the RGB lighting path is unused.
inputs_detected: E, F, I, L, M, O, Q, R, S, U, W, Z
